referenceState: Present-day restored ochre hall and truncated gatehouse, not the historical tall-towered Forework.
identityFeatures: Ochre Great Hall with crow-stepped gables and paired projecting bays
Renaissance palace and open Lion's Den courtyard
Low round gatehouse towers and elongated fortified enclosure
scope: Castle exterior and simplified walled compound. No interiors, off-site gardens, esplanade or cliff terrain.
reuse: Reference URLs only. HES illustrations and photographs are not redistributed or embedded as textures.
uncertainty: Relative ground levels, heights, roof pitches and ornamental rhythm are estimates. Exact geographic fit on the volcanic outcrop requires terrain-aware review. The compound boundary must not be treated as one building footprint.
